args.evidence: The not_null_fct_orders_region_name test failed with 14625 null region_name rows. In fct_orders the join to dim_customers used o.order_key = c.customer_key, which never matches, producing null region_name. Changing the join to o.customer_key = c.customer_key correctly links orders to customers, restoring region_name and passing all checks.
